title: PySpark toPandas faster alternative
question:
Is there a faster alternative to convert a PySpark dataframe to a pandas dataframe? I do have "spark.sql.execution.arrow.enabled" set to "true", but it is still taking hours to convert a dataframe. I have also tried writing to parquet from spark and then reading it back in using arrow, but writing is taking hours as well.

Bonus, is there any way to have a spark process fail quickly? Sometimes, in the above situations, I find out hours later that the reason the conversion took so long was because of a schema datatype mismap, if only I could have not waited hours to get that failure.
answer:
I experience the same issue. I have to convert the spark dataframe to local machine for deep learning trainning. Data size with 30g takes days to convert using filter.
One solution is save data to a hive table first and using hdfs operation copy data to local. The data department solved the problem for me. It now using only 1 hour to copy 30g data. And if you have hdfs privilege you can use spark hdfs api.

    sc = spark.sparkContext
    # Get the JVM view
    jvm = sc._jvm
    # Get the Hadoop Configuration
    conf = sc.hadoopConfiguration()
    # Get the Hadoop FileSystem object
    fs = jvm.org.apache.hadoop.fs.FileSystem.get(conf)

    # Create Hadoop Path objects
    # For HDFS path, the scheme (hdfs://namenode:port) is usually inferred from core-site.xml
    hdfs_path = jvm.org.apache.hadoop.fs.Path(hdfs_path_str)
    fs.copyToLocalFile(False, hdfs_path, local_path)
